title: Term Aggregate and Aggregate Reinstatement Terms by FloodPay Tier
content:
Under FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines), the payout capacity available in a term — the term aggregate — is fixed as a multiple of the tier's payout limit, and on some tiers used capacity can be bought back during the term. This table states those settings for every FloodPay tier.

| Tier | Term aggregate multiple (times the payout limit) | Aggregate reinstatement available | Reinstatement premium rate (% of the amount reinstated, pro rata for the remaining term) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 2 | No | 0 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 2 | No | 0 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 2 | No | 0 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 2 | Yes | 3.9 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 2 | Yes | 3.7 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 2 | Yes | 3.4 |

## Reading the table

- **Term aggregate multiple** — the term aggregate is the tier's payout limit multiplied by this number. Every tier uses a multiple of 2.
- **Aggregate reinstatement available** — whether used aggregate can be bought back mid-term. It is not available on the FloodPay Home 5K, Home 10K or Home 25K tiers, and it is available on the FloodPay Business 50K, Business 100K and Business 250K tiers.
- **Reinstatement premium rate** — the premium to buy back used aggregate, as a percent of the amount reinstated, applied pro rata for the remaining term. The rate is 3.9 percent on FloodPay Business 50K, 3.7 percent on FloodPay Business 100K and 3.4 percent on FloodPay Business 250K. The Home tiers show a rate of 0 because reinstatement is not offered on them.

## Term aggregate in dollars

Multiplying each tier's payout limit by the multiple of 2 gives the term aggregate:

| Tier | Payout limit (USD) | Term aggregate (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 5,000 | 10,000 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 10,000 | 20,000 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 25,000 | 50,000 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 50,000 | 100,000 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 100,000 | 200,000 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 250,000 | 500,000 |
